blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Decision models enable fast, confidence-aware decisions by scoring candidate answers in a single forward pass, without generating text or intermediate reasoning. Yet reasoning can substantially improve decision quality, raising the question of whether its benefits can be retained without the cost of generating it. We investigate this question with \textbf{GLiDE}, a family of decision models spanning 0.4B to 27B parameters.
  Building on Qwen hybrid language models, GLiDE enables bidirectional interactions between the context, question, and candidate answers by removing causal masking from full-attention layers. To transfer reasoning capabilities into single-pass inference, we combine soft-target distillation from multiple teachers, including a reasoning model, with progressive post-training on diverse decision tasks. We further explore parameter-free recurrent depth to increase inference-time computation without generating tokens.
  Across five model sizes, GLiDE lies on the performance--parameter Pareto frontier of the Hugging Face \DI{}, with each model outperforming evaluated alternatives of equal or smaller size. \dmtwo{} (27B) achieves a hidden-set score of 71.52, with an expected calibration error of 2.0\% and a median latency of 92.9\,ms on a single GPU. Further checkpoint averaging and parameter-free recurrent depth yield GLiDE~27B, which reaches 73.37 with an expected calibration error of 2.1\%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models are increasingly used not only to generate text, but also to make decisions: selecting tools, routing requests, classifying inputs, and choosing among predefined actions. In these settings, generating an answer token by token is often unnecessary. Decision models instead score candidate answers in a single forward pass, producing a probability distribution over the available choices. This approach has evolved from compact, schema-conditioned encoders such as GLiNER2 ( Zaratiana et al., 2025 ) to larger systems including Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) , Decider ( Perplexity AI, 2026 ) , and Mammoth ( Kirkby et al., 2026 ) . Yet a central tension remains: multi-step reasoning can substantially improve decision quality, while generating that reasoning introduces precisely the sequential computation that decision models seek to avoid. The challenge is therefore to capture the benefits of reasoning while retaining the speed of direct prediction, without sacrificing calibration or generalization ( Tian et al., 2023 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Recht et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型不仅越来越多地用于生成文本,而且还用于决策:选择工具,路由请求,对输入进行分类,在预先定义的行动中进行选择. 在这些设置中,通过符号生成一个答录符往往是不必要的. 决策模型则通过一次前传给候选人的答案进行评分,从而产生对现有选择的概率分布。 这种方法已经从紧凑的,有计划条件的编码器如GLiNER2(Zaratiana等人,2025年)演变为更大的系统,包括Jev(TypeSafe AI,2026年),决定者. blocks.en: We introduce GLiDE , a family of single-pass decision models spanning 0.4B to 27B parameters. Starting from Qwen hybrid language models, we remove causal masking from their full-attention layers, allowing the context, question, and candidate answers to interact bidirectionally while retaining causal Gated DeltaNet layers (Figure 2 ). A dedicated readout then produces probabilities over the offered options. To transfer reasoning-informed supervision into this architecture, we combine soft-target distillation from multiple teachers, including a model evaluated after reasoning, with progressive post-training on diverse decision tasks. In this way, GLiDE learns from the distributions produced by reasoning without generating intermediate reasoning at inference time.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了GLiDE, 一组单通道决定模型 跨0.4B到27B参数。 从Quen混合语言模型开始,我们从他们的全心全意层中去除因果遮罩,允许上下文,提问和候选答案双向交互,同时保留因果Gated DeltaNet层(图2). 然后,专用读出就会产生对所提供选项的概率。 为了将基于推理的监管转移到这一结构中,我们把来自多个教师的软目标提炼(包括一个经过推理评估的模式)与关于多种决策任务的渐进式后培训结合起来。 通过这种方式,GLiDE从推理产生的分布中学习,而不在推论时间产生中间推理.

blocks.en: We first evaluate GLiDE on the Hugging Face Decision Index ( Passos, 2026a ) , which ranks models using independently administered hidden test sets. On edition 0.4.1 (22 October 2026), GLiDE V1.2 (27B) achieves a score of 71.52, ranking first among 225 models and outperforming the runner-up by 1.77 points (Figure 4 ). It also leads on both hidden components, covering unseen questions from established skills and decisions in new domains. This performance is accompanied by an expected calibration error of 2.0% and a median latency of 92.9 ms on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, demonstrating that strong decision accuracy can coexist with reliable confidence estimates and efficient inference.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在Hugging Face决策指数(Passos, 2026a)上评价GLiDE, 在0.4.1版(2026年10月22日)上,GLiDE V1.2(27B)取得了71.52分的成绩,在225个型号中排名第一,并以1.77分(图4)的成绩超越了跑步者. 它还在两个隐蔽部分中起带头作用,涵盖新领域既有技能和决策的无形问题。 伴随这种性能的还有预期的校准误差2.0%,在单张RTX PRO 6000 GPU上的中位恒温为92.9 ms,表明强大的决定精度可以与可靠的信心估计和高效推论共存.

blocks.en: The Hugging Face Decision Index evaluates submitted models using private test sets administered by the benchmark maintainers. As of November 15, 2026, GLiDE models achieved competitive performance across multiple leaderboard revisions, with GLiDE 27B scoring 73.37 on the hidden evaluation sets. All five model sizes also lie on the reported performance–parameter Pareto frontier.
blocks.zh: 套头决定指数使用由基准维护者管理的私人测试集来评价所提交的模型。 截至2026年11月15日,GLiDE模式在多个头板修改中实现了竞争性表现,GLiDE 27B在隐藏评价集上评分73.37. 所有五个模型大小都位于所报告的性能参数Pareto前沿。

blocks.en: Finally, we investigate how the approach extends across model sizes and inference-time computation budgets. We develop four smaller GLiDE models through progressive training and distillation from the 27B model. All five models lie on the performance–parameter Pareto frontier of the Hugging Face Decision Index, each outperforming every evaluated alternative of equal or smaller size. We also investigate parameter-free recurrent depth, which increases computation by reapplying selected middle layers without introducing new weights or generating tokens. Combined with further checkpoint averaging, this produces GLiDE 27B, which reaches 73.37 on the Hugging Face Decision Index with an expected calibration error of 2.1%. Together, these results establish GLiDE as a family of fast, calibrated decision models that benefit from reasoning-informed training without requiring explicit reasoning generation at inference time.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们调查这一方法如何跨越模型规模和推断时间的计算预算。 我们通过27B模型的渐进式培训和蒸馏,开发了四个较小的GLIDE模型. 所有五个模型都位于Hugging Face决策指数的性能参数Pareto边框上,每个模型的性能都比每个评估的大小相同或较小的替代品要好。 我们还调查无参数的重复深度,它通过重新应用选定的中层来增加计算,而不引入新的权重或生成符号. 加上进一步的检查站平均值,这产生了GLiDE 27B,在Hugging Face决定指数上达到73.37,预计校准误差为2.1%。 这些结果共同将GLiDE确立为一组快速,校准的决定模型,这些模型受益于推理知情培训,而不需要在推断时明确推理生成.

blocks.en: Taken together, these findings show that strong, calibrated decision performance can be achieved across model scales without generating explicit reasoning at inference time. More broadly, GLiDE demonstrates how reasoning-informed supervision and additional computation within the model can improve decision quality while preserving the efficiency of direct candidate scoring.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这些调查结果表明,在推论时,可在不产生明确推理的情况下,跨模型尺度实现有力、有校准的决策业绩。 更广泛地说,GLiDE表明,在模型内进行有推理依据的监督和额外计算可以提高决策质量,同时保持直接候选人评分的效率。

We first adapt Qwen3.8-27B using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) in two steps. We begin by generating reasoning traces
for training questions and retaining approximately
6,400 examples whose reasoning leads to the correct
answer. Rank-64 LoRA adapters are trained on these
examples with the base weights frozen, using
next-token prediction on the reasoning traces and
cross-entropy on the final answers. Next, the adapted model reasons over approximately
135K additional questions, and we collect its
post-thinking probability distributions over the
candidate answers. A second LoRA round trains the
model to predict these distributions directly, without
producing written reasoning. The resulting teacher
can operate with or without explicit reasoning,
providing both direct and post-thinking predictions
for subsequent distillation. This is the only stage
that uses LoRA.

blocks.en: 5.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要成果

blocks.en:
Does GLiDE V1.2 decide better than other models on questions it has never seen? Table 1 reports results on the Hugging Face Decision Index (edition 0.4.1, 22 October 2026). GLiDE V1.2 achieves a Full score of 71.52, ranking first of 225 models, 1.77 points ahead of Jeffan-31B; this margin is about twice the board’s 0.9-point tie margin, while six models share third place within 0.9 points of one another. GLiDE V1.2 is also first on each hidden component: 68.31 on same-skill (next best 65.98) and 76.32 on new-domain (next best 75.58).
Figure 4 shows that this lead does not come at the cost of calibration or speed. Every model with better calibration scores at most 61.3, and every faster model scores at most 68.0. A comparison with Drex Max ( Dhankhar et al., 2026 ) helps isolate the effect of training. Drex Max starts from the same Qwen3.8-27B base and makes the same two architectural changes: non-causal attention and a 255-way readout. It scores 66.60 on this board, 4.92 points below GLiDE V1.2 . The two models share a backbone and readout but differ in how they were trained.
blocks.zh:

图4显示,这种铅不会以校准或速度为代价。 每个型号的校准分更好的分数最多61.3分,每个较快的型号的分数最多68.0. 与Drex Max(Dhankhhar等人,2026年)的比较有助于隔离训练的效果. Drex Max从相同的Qwen3.8-27B基数开始,并做出相同的两个建筑变化:非caus关注和255路读取. 它在这个板子上得分66.60分,在GLIDE V1.2以下4.92分. 两种模式共用骨干和阅读,但培训方式不同。

blocks.en: Does the model do as well on hidden questions as on public ones? GLiDE V1.2 ’s Full score is 0.47 points below its public score. Across the 225 models, Full scores track public ones (slope 0.98, Spearman ρ = 0.95 \rho=0.95 ) but sit about 4 points lower; a model with GLiDE V1.2 ’s public score is expected to reach 67.3, and GLiDE V1.2 ’s 71.52 lies inside the 95% prediction interval [55.0, 79.5] of a fit that excludes it. The small gap is consistent with good generalization, although a single benchmark cannot establish distribution-wide robustness.

blocks.en: 5.2 Calibration and Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.2 校准和效率

blocks.en:
When the model says it is 90% sure, is it right about 90% of the time? GLiDE V1.2 has an expected calibration error of 2.0% (10 bins on the board’s sample; interval about [1.7, 2.4]), the lowest among the ten highest-ranked models (Table 7 ). Its mean confidence exceeds its accuracy by 1.1 points (82.6% vs. 81.5%), whereas the other nine are overconfident by 2.5 to 10.5 points. The 56% of its answers given with confidence above 0.9 are correct 97.4% of the time. Its Brier score, which mixes calibration and accuracy, is slightly higher than those of three models that are 0.9–1.3 points more accurate on this sample.
We apply no correction after training, such as a fitted temperature. The probabilities are the plain softmax of the readout, so the calibration is a result of training and not of a later fix. Calibration differs by task area: ECE is 1.8% on language tasks, 3.5% on retrieval, 3.9% on tools, 4.2% on arts and 7.5% on knowledge. Figure 4 c plots confidence against accuracy.
blocks.zh:
当模型说它90%肯定, 是不是90%的时间是正确的? GLiDE V1.2的预期校准误差为2.0%(在棋盘样本中为10个盒;间隔约为[1.7,2.4]),是排名最高的10个模型中最低的(表7 ). 其平均置信度超过其准确度1.1分(82.6%对81.5%),而其他9个则超过其2.5至10.5分。 56%的回答充满信心地给出了0.9以上的回答,这在97.4%的时间里是正确的. 它的布赖尔分数混合了校准和精度,略高于三个模型的分数,这三种模型在这个样本上更准确0.9–1.3分.
训练后我们不进行校正,如温度适中。 概率是读出时的普通软度,因此校准是训练的结果,而不是后来的固定. 校准因任务领域而异:欧洲经委会在语言任务方面为1.8%,在检索方面为3.5%,在工具方面为3.9%,在艺术方面为4.2%,在知识方面为7.5%。 图4c显示的置信度不准确。

blocks.en: If an application acts only when the model is confident, how accurate are those answers? Table 6 answers this on the same sample. Accepting every answer gives 81.5% accuracy. Accepting only answers with a confidence of at least 0.8 keeps 68% of them, and 95.0% of those are correct. At 0.9, 56% are kept and 97.4% are correct. An application can therefore trade coverage for accuracy by setting a threshold, with no retraining (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 如果应用程序只在模型充满信心时才起作用,这些答案究竟有多准确? 表6在同一样本中回答了这一问题。 接受每个答案的准确度为81.5%。 仅以至少0.8的自信接受答案,保留了其中的68%,其中95.0%是正确的. 在0.9时,保留了56%,97.4%是正确的。 因此,申请可以通过设定一个门槛,不进行再培训来进行准确性交易(附录C)。

blocks.en:
How fast is the model? GLiDE V1.2 has a median latency of 92.9 ms on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, 1.3 × 1.3\times faster than Jeffan-31B, 2.4 × 2.4\times faster than mammoth-1 and 2.1 × 2.1\times faster than d3-turbo v1.1; every faster model on the board scores at least 3.5 points lower.
Figure 4 b shows score against latency for all models.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Which part of the single-pass conversion helps: removing the causal mask, training on soft targets, or both? Table 3 changes one thing per row. The first row is the Stage 1 model before any conversion training. The second keeps the causal mask and trains on gold labels. The third removes the mask. The fourth replaces gold labels with soft targets. The last also re-formats 30% of the examples. The table reports a composite development score, held-out accuracy, and sensitivity to input-format perturbations.
blocks.zh: 单通道转换的哪一部分有帮助:去掉因果面具,软目标训练,还是两者兼而有之? 表3每行改变一件事。 第一排是任何转换训练之前的阶段1模型. 二号机车将因果口罩和列车保留在金色标签上. 第三解脱遮. 第四部以软目标取代金牌. 最后一个还重制了30%的例子. 该表报告综合发展分数、持有的准确性以及对输入格式扰动的敏感性。

blocks.en: Table 3 compares single-pass conversion variants trained on the same 125K examples with one seed. Removing the causal mask raises the development score from 60.42 to 61.78 and reduces format sensitivity from 1.25 to 0.22 points; adding soft targets raises the development score to 62.59 and held-out accuracy to 89.16%. All three measures move in the same direction, but each step is within single-seed variability, so we treat these results as indicative rather than conclusive. Format augmentation did not help and was not retained.
blocks.zh: 表3将用同样的125K实例培训的单路转换变体与一个种子进行比较。 移除因果面罩将发展分数从60.42提高到61.78,并将格式敏感性从1.25分降低到0.22分;增加软目标将发展分数提升到62.59分,搁置精度提升到89.16%. 所有这三项措施都朝同一方向发展,但每个步骤都在单一种子的可变性范围内,因此我们将这些结果视为指示性的而不是决定性的. 格式增强没有帮助,也没有保留。

An undamped step ( η = 1 \eta=1 ) overshoots.

blocks.en: 6 Recurrent Depth and Model Scaling
blocks.zh: 6 经常性深度和模型放大

blocks.en: We investigate two extensions of GLiDE V1.2 : increasing inference-time computation without introducing additional parameters, and transferring the training procedure to smaller model scales. Figure 5 summarizes the resulting model lineage. Unless stated otherwise, development uses internal evaluation data and reported comparisons use separate held-out sets. Hugging Face Decision Index scores are externally administered measurements from edition 0.4.1 ( Passos, 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 我们调查了GLiDE V1.2的两个延伸:增加推论时间计算而不引入额外的参数,以及将培训程序转移到较小的模型尺度. 图5概括了由此产生的模式血统。 除非另有说明,开发使用内部评价数据,报告的比较使用单独的搁置数据。 拥抱面额决策指数分数是从第0.4.1版(Passos, 2026b )中外部管理的计量.

blocks.en: 6.1 GLiDE 27B
blocks.zh: 6.1 GLIDE 27B (英语).

blocks.en: We train two additional checkpoints from the same lineage on broader mixtures of approximately 1.7 million questions each. Individually, they change held-out performance by + 0.21 +0.21 and − 0.20 -0.20 points and do not satisfy the predefined improvement threshold of + 0.5 +0.5 . We then form a convex parameter average assigning weight 1 / 2 1/2 to GLiDE V1.2 and 1 / 4 1/4 to each additional checkpoint. The averaged model improves held-out performance by 0.86 0.86 points. This result is consistent with prior observations that checkpoints from a shared fine-tuning lineage can remain connected in weight space ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ; Izmailov et al., 2018 ) . Across the complete lineage, training uses approximately 3.9 billion tokens from 3.4 million distinct questions.
blocks.zh: 我们从同一个地区再培训两个检查站,每个检查站都使用大约170万个问题的广泛混合物。 它们单独地将被搁置的性能改变为+0.21+0.21和−0.20-0.20分,不符合预先确定的+0.5+0.5的改进阈值. 然后,我们形成一个对流参数平均值,将重量1 / 2 1/2分配给GLIDE V1.2,每个新增检查站1 / 4 1/4。 平均模型提高了被搁置的性能0.860.86分. 这一结果与先前的观察一致,即共用微调线的检查站仍可在重量空间连接(Wortsman等人,2022年;Izmailov等人,2018年)。 在整个学系中,培训使用340万个不同问题中的大约39亿个符号。

blocks.en: GLiDE 27B uses the parameters of the averaged model without further training. At inference time, two middle blocks—layers 24–35 and 36–47 of the 64-layer network—are each applied twice. For a block map F F , the recurrent update is x k + 1 = x k + η [ F ( x k ) − x k ] , k = 0 , 1 , η = 1 2 , x_{k+1}=x_{k}+\eta\,[F(x_{k})-x_{k}],\;\;k=0,1,\;\;\eta=\tfrac{1}{2}, (15) where x 0 x_{0} is the block input and x 2 x_{2} is passed to the subsequent layer. Equation 15 defines a damped fixed-point iteration related to weight-tied and recurrent-depth networks ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Bai et al., 2019 ; Geiping et al., 2025 ; Saunshi et al., 2025 ) . It adds computation but no trainable parameters. The damping coefficient limits the distribution shift presented to downstream layers; in our experiments, the undamped update ( η = 1 \eta=1 ) performs worse. Figure 6 illustrates the procedure.
blocks.zh: GLiDE 27B使用平均模型的参数,无需进一步训练. 在推论中,64层网络的两个中间区块——24至35层和36至47层——各适用两次。 对于区块地图F,经常性更新为x k + 1 = x k + + + → [F (x k) - x k], k = 0, 1, = 1, = 1 2, x + + 1 x X X X X X X X X X X X X X X eta\\\\\\\\\, [F (x (x) )],\; k= 0, 1\\;\\ etat frac{ 1}, (15) 是区块输入, x 0 x X X X X X X X X X X X X X → 2} } 传递到下层 。 方程式15定义了与重力和经常性深度网络有关的坝顶固定点迭代(Dehghani等人,2019年;Bai等人,2019年;Geiping等人,2025年;Saunshi等人,2025年)。 它增加了计算,但没有可训练参数。 坝积系数限制了向下游地层呈现的分布转移;在我们实验中,被淹没的更新(η=1\eta=1)表现更差. 图6说明了程序。

blocks.en: Candidate configurations vary the repeated layer blocks, recurrence count, and damping schedule. Configuration choice uses internal development data. We compare the selected configuration with the averaged-model baseline on two separate held-out sets.
blocks.zh: 候选人的配置会改变重复的层块,重现计数,以及停工时间表. 配置选择使用内部开发数据. 我们把所选配置与两套单独搁置的模型基准进行比较。

blocks.en: Recurrent depth improves the two held-out scores by 0.69 0.69 points (interval [ 0.02 , 1.42 ] [0.02,1.42] ) and 0.56 0.56 points ( [ 0.27 , 0.89 ] [0.27,0.89] ), respectively. GLiDE 27B obtains a hidden-set score of 73.37, compared with 71.52 for GLiDE V1.2 ; this difference includes both parameter averaging and recurrent depth. Median latency increases from 92.9 to 122 ms because 24 of the 64 layers are evaluated twice. Calibration remains similar, with ECE increasing from 2.0% to 2.1%. On the benchmark calibration sample, 58% of predictions have confidence above 0.9, of which 97.3% are correct.
blocks.zh: 经常性深度使两个被搁置的分数分别提高了0.69 0.69分(中间分数[0.02,1.42])和0.56 0.56分([0.27,0.89] [0.27,0.89])). GLiDE 27B获得73.37的隐藏集分,而GLiDE V1.2则获得71.52;这一差异既包括参数平均值,也包括重复深度. 由于64层中有24层经过两次评估,中间延缓度从92.9米增加到122米。 校准情况仍然类似,欧洲经委会的校准率从2.0%增至2.1%。 在基准校准样本中,58%的预测置信度高于0.9,其中97.3%正确.

blocks.en: Applying each block three times performs worse than applying it twice, and introducing trainable loop parameters does not improve over the parameter-free update. High-learning-rate distillation and alternative parameter averages also fail to improve held-out performance.
blocks.zh: 应用每个块3次的性能比应用它2次更差,引入可训练循环参数不会比无参数更新更好. 高学习率的蒸馏法和替代参数平均值也未能改善搁置业绩。

blocks.en: 6.2 Scaling Across Model Sizes
blocks.zh: 6.2 跨模型大小的放大

blocks.en: We construct four smaller variants: GLiDE 9B, 2B, 0.8B, and 0.4B. The 9B, 2B, and 0.8B variants use base models with the same hybrid architecture and tokenizer as Qwen3.8-27B, allowing the examples and option labels from Section 3 to transfer directly. A final distillation epoch trains each model to match the complete output distribution of GLiDE 27B over 3.4 million questions. This step improves held-out performance by 2.4 points at 0.8B parameters and 1.1 points at 2B parameters. GLiDE 9B additionally uses low-learning-rate distillation, parameter averaging, and recurrent depth. GLiDE 0.4B uses a bidirectional encoder trained against the same 27B output distributions. Generating labels for the 3.4 million-question corpus required 4.5 hours on 22 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了四个较小的变体:GLIDE 9B,2B,0.8B和0.4B. 9B,2B,和0.8B的变体使用与Quen3.8-27B相同的混合式架构和标致器的基模型,使得第3节中的例子和选项标签可以直接转移. 最终的蒸馏时代列车每个车型,以匹配GLiDE 27B超过340万个问题的完整输出分布. 这一步骤提高了0.8B参数的2.4分和2B参数的1.1分。 GLiDE 9B额外采用了低学习率的蒸馏法,参数平均法和重复深度法. GLiDE 0.4B使用一个双向编码器,针对相同的27B输出分布而训练. 制作340万个问题集的标签需要22 GPU的4.5小时。

blocks.en: Before training, later data underwent repeated near-duplicate screening using n-gram overlap, MinHash similarity, and item-level rules. Matching questions were dropped and not replaced. Appendix E.2 describes the corresponding controls for the final-stage mixture.
blocks.zh: 在培训之前,后来利用正克重叠、MinHash相似度和项目级规则多次对数据进行了近似重复的筛选。 匹配问题被放弃而不是被替换 。 附录E.2说明了对最后阶段混合物的相应控制。

All five GLiDE models lie on the score--parameter Pareto frontier and exceed every evaluated alternative of equal or smaller size by 3.2 to 10.9 points. Median latency ranges from 18 to 122 ms. GLiDE 27B has the second-highest score among 300 models, while GLiDE 9B is the smallest listed model that exceeds the Jev 1.14 reference score. The public weights for all five models are available online. 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/fastino

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced GLiDE V1.2 , a decision model that distills reasoning into a single forward pass. By combining non-causal full attention, a dedicated option readout, and multi-teacher distillation, the model produces calibrated probabilities over candidate decisions without generating intermediate reasoning. On the Hugging Face Decision Index (edition 0.4.1, 22 October 2026), GLiDE V1.2 achieves a score of 71.52, ranking first among 225 models and leading on both hidden evaluation sets, with an expected calibration error of 2.0% and a median latency of 92.9 ms. These results extend beyond the initial model. Without retraining, GLiDE V1.2 remains within 0.6 points of the highest score across three versions of the Artificial Analysis Decision Index. Further checkpoint averaging and parameter-free recurrent depth yield GLiDE 27B, which reaches 73.37 without introducing additional parameters. Across five model sizes spanning 0.4B to 27B parameters, each GLiDE model outperforms all evaluated alternatives of equal or smaller size. Together, these findings demonstrate that reasoning-informed training can enable strong, calibrated decision-making across model scales while preserving the efficiency of direct inference.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了GLiDE V1.2, 一种将推理提炼成单一前传的决定模型. 通过结合非因果全注,专用选项读取,以及多教师衍射,该模型在不产生中间推理的情况下产生校准候选人决定的概率. 在Hugging Face决策指数(edition 0.4.1,2026年10月22日)上,GLiDE V1.2的得分为71.52,在225个模型中排名第一,并领先于两个隐藏的评价集,预期校准误差为2.0%,中位值为92.9ms. 这些结果超出了最初的模式。 不进行再培训,GLiDE V1.2仍保持在人工分析决定指数三个版本最高分的0.6分以内. 进一步的检查站平均和无参数的重复深度为GLiDE 27B,达到73.37,但没有增加参数。 从0.4B到27B参数的5个模型大小来看,每个GLIDE模型的绩效都超过所有评价的大小相同或较小的替代品。 这些调查结果合在一起表明,根据推理进行知情培训可以促进在模型尺度上作出强有力的、经过调整的决策,同时保持直接推论的效率。

blocks.en: Appendix A From a language model to a decision model, step by step
blocks.zh: 从语文模式到决定模式,逐步

blocks.en: This appendix explains in plain terms how GLiDE V1.2 is built from its base language model. It assumes only a basic knowledge of transformers. Sections 2 and 3 give the formal version, and Table 9 summarizes the changes.
blocks.zh: 本附录简单解释GLiDE V1.2如何从其基础语言模型中构建. 它只假定变压器的基本知识. 第2和第3节给出了正式版本,表9概述了这些改动。

blocks.en: A.1 The starting point
blocks.zh: A.1 联合国 起点

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B is an ordinary language model: it reads a sequence of tokens and predicts the next one. It has 64 layers and a hidden size of 5,120, and its last layer gives a score to each of about 248,000 vocabulary tokens. The layers are of two kinds. • 16 self-attention layers. In each, every token looks back at the earlier tokens and combines what it finds. • 48 Gated DeltaNet layers. Each reads the sequence from left to right and carries a running summary, much like a recurrent network. Its cost grows linearly with the length of the input, which keeps long documents cheap. Both kinds are causal : a token can use only what comes before it. A model that writes text one token at a time needs this, because the later tokens do not exist yet.
blocks.zh: Qune3.8-27B是一种普通语言模型:它读取一个符号序列,并预测下一个符号序列. 它有64层,隐藏大小为5,120个,其最后一层给每个约248,000个词汇符记一个分. 地层分为两种. • 16个自觉层。 在每一个符号中,每个符号都回顾以前的符号,并结合它发现的东西. • 48 Gated Delta 网层. 每个都读到从左到右的序列,并带一个运行中的摘要,很像一个经常性的网络. 其成本随着输入长度的线性增长,使得长的文件价格低廉. 这两类都是因果:一个符号只能使用它之前的事物. 一个一次写一个符号的模型需要这个,因为后来的符号还不存在.

blocks.en: 16 self-attention layers. In each, every token looks back at the earlier tokens and combines what it finds.
blocks.zh: 十六自心层. 在每一个符号中,每个符号都回顾以前的符号,并结合它发现的东西.

blocks.en: 48 Gated DeltaNet layers. Each reads the sequence from left to right and carries a running summary, much like a recurrent network. Its cost grows linearly with the length of the input, which keeps long documents cheap.
blocks.zh: 48 加德三角洲 网层. 每个都读到从左到右的序列,并带一个运行中的摘要,很像一个经常性的网络. 其成本随着输入长度的线性增长,使得长的文件价格低廉.

blocks.en: A.2 The goal
blocks.zh: A.2 联合国 目标

blocks.en: A decision model answers a different kind of request. It receives a context, a question and a list of options, and returns one probability per option. For example: Context: Order 1182. The parcel arrived damaged; two photos attached. Question: What should the agent do next? Options: (A) refund  (B) replace  (C) escalate  (D) ask for more information Wanted output: A 0.64,  B 0.21,  C 0.11,  D 0.04 A language model could answer this by writing text, but that has three drawbacks. Writing is slow, because every generated token needs another pass through the network. The text has to be parsed. And the probabilities of the options are not given directly. Letting the model reason step by step before it answers improves accuracy, but multiplies the cost.
blocks.zh: 一个决定模式可以回答不同的要求。 它收到一个上下文,一个问题和一个选项列表,并返回每个选项的一个概率. 例如: 背景:命令1182. 包裹运抵后损坏;附有两张照片。 问题: 特工下一步怎么办? 选项:(A) 退款(B) 替换(C) 升级(D) 索取更多信息 想要的产出:A 0.64,B 0.21,C 0.11,D 0.04 一个语言模型可以通过写文字来回答这个问题,但这有三个缺点。 写作很慢,因为每个生成的令牌都需要另一个通过网络. 文字须解. 而选项的概率并不直接给出. 让模型在解答之前一步步地解释理由可以提高准确性,但成本可以乘以乘.

blocks.en: We want the accuracy of the reasoning model at the cost of a single pass. The six steps below get there.
blocks.zh: 我们想要推理模型的准确性 以一个通行证为代价 下六台阶即到.

blocks.en: A.3 Step 1: write the request as one prompt
blocks.zh: A.3 步骤1:将请求写成一个提示

blocks.en: The context, the question and the options are placed in a single prompt. Each option is given a one-token code (A, B, C, …). The prompt ends with the prefix “ Answer: ( ”, so that the next token a language model would write is the code of its answer.
blocks.zh: 将上下文、问题和选项放在一个提示中。 每个选项都得到一个一键代码(A,B,C,...). 提示以前缀“ 回答:( ) ” 结尾, 这样一个语言模型会写的下一个符号就是它的回答代码 。

blocks.en: A.4 Step 2: read the answer from one position
blocks.zh: A.4 步骤2:从一个位置读出答案

blocks.en: The network turns the prompt into one vector per token. We keep only the vector at the last token, h h , which has 5,120 numbers. A small matrix W W with 255 rows, one for each possible option code, turns h h into 255 scores, z = W ​ h z=Wh . We keep the scores of the options that were actually offered (four in the example) and apply a softmax. The result is one probability per option, and the probabilities sum to one.
blocks.zh: 网络将提示转换为每个符号的一个矢量. 我们只保留矢量 在最后一个符号,hhh, 它有5,120个数字。 一个包含255行的小型矩阵 W W,每个可能的选项代码各一个,将h h变为255分,z=Wh z=Wh. 我们保留实际提供的选项的分数(例中4个),并应用软马克斯. 结果是每个选项一个概率,概率和一个概率。

blocks.en: This readout replaces the original output layer, which scored 248,000 tokens. W W does not start from random values: each row is copied from the original output layer’s row for the same code token. So before any training, the readout scores option A exactly as the language model scored the token A.
blocks.zh: 这个读出取代了原输出层,输出层得分为24.8万令牌. W W不是从随机值开始的:每行是从原始输出层的行复制到同一代码符的. 因此在任何训练之前,读取的分数A与语言模型的分数A完全相同.

blocks.en: There are 255 rows because we use 255 single-token codes: the 26 letters, then two-letter codes. A question can therefore have at most 255 options.
blocks.zh: 共有255行,因为我们使用255个单键代码:26个字母,然后是2个字母代码. 因此,一个问题最多可以有255种选择。

blocks.en: A.5 Step 3: let every token see the whole prompt
blocks.zh: A.5 步骤3:让每个标志看到整个提示

blocks.en: In a language model, the attention mask lets token i i attend only to tokens 1 , … , i 1,\ldots,i . For a decision, this restriction is unnecessary, because the whole prompt is known before the model starts. It is also harmful: the context is read before the question has been seen, and option A is read before options B, C and D.
blocks.zh: 在语言模型中,注意面罩允许我只出席1,...,i 1,\ldots,i。 对于一个决定来说,这种限制是不必要的,因为整个提示在模型开始前就已经知道. 这也是有害的:在看到问题之前先读上下文,在备选案文B、C和D之前读备选案文A。

blocks.en: We remove the mask in the 16 self-attention layers. Every token can then attend to every other token. The model can read the context knowing the question, and it can compare the options with each other. We leave the 48 Gated DeltaNet layers unchanged. They are recurrent by design, and leaving them alone keeps their linear cost.
blocks.zh: 我们把16个自我观察层的面具摘了 然后,每个标志可以处理其他每个标志。 模型可以读取了解问题的上下文,可以互相比较选择. 我们让48 Gated DeltaNet层保持不变。 它们从设计上来说是反复出现的,放过它们会保持其线性成本.

blocks.en: Two consequences follow. First, the model can no longer write text, because writing depends on the mask. Second, the pretrained weights have never seen “future” tokens, so the model has to be trained before it can use them. That is the job of the next step.
blocks.zh: 后结二果. 首先,模型不能再写文字,因为写作取决于面具. 第二,预先训练的重量从未见过"未来"的标志,因此该模型必须经过训练才能使用. 这是下一步的工作。

blocks.en: A.6 Step 4: train on probabilities, not only on answers
blocks.zh: A.6 第4步:关于概率的训练,而不仅仅是关于答案的训练

blocks.en: Each training example consists of a prompt, the correct option, and a target distribution over the options, supplied by one or more teacher models. The loss (Equation 11 ) adds two terms: 0.3 times the cross-entropy with the correct option, and 0.7 times the KL divergence from the target distribution.
blocks.zh: 每个培训实例包括一个即时、正确的选择,以及由一个或多个教师模式提供的目标分布。 损失(方程式11 )增加了两个术语:0.3倍带有正确选项的横切,0.7倍KL与目标分布的差.

blocks.en: The second term is what separates this from ordinary classification training. A label says only that A is right. A target such as ( 0.70 , 0.05 , 0.25 , 0.00 ) (0.70,\,0.05,\,0.25,\,0.00) also says that C is a plausible alternative and that D is not. A student trained on such targets learns how sure to be, not only what to answer. This is where the model’s calibration comes from. No temperature or other correction is fitted after training.
blocks.zh: 第二个术语是将此与普通分类培训区分开来的内容. 一个标签只说A是正确的。 诸如(0.70,0.05,0.25,0.00)等目标(0.70,\,0.05,\,0.25,\,0.00)也称C是可行的替代品,D不是. 一个受过此类目标培训的学生学会了如何确定,而不仅仅是如何回答。 这就是模型校准的来源。 训练后没有安装温度或其他校正。

blocks.en: A.7 Step 5: move the thinking into training
blocks.zh: A.7 步骤5:将思维转入培训

blocks.en: One teacher is a version of the base model itself that reasons before it answers (Stage 1 in Section 3 ). For each training question we let this teacher write out its reasoning, and then record the probability it gives to each option. The student never sees the reasoning text. It sees only the distribution that the teacher reached after thinking, and learns to produce that distribution directly.
blocks.zh: 一名教师是基础模型本身的版本,这是它回答之前的原因(第3节第1段)。 对于每个训练问题,我们让这位老师写出其推理,然后记录它给每个选项的概率. 学生从不看推理文字. 它只看到教师在思考后到达的分布,学会直接制作这种分布.

blocks.en: The cost of thinking is therefore paid once, during training, and not on every request. Thinking does not help on every question. If the teacher is already confident without reasoning, we use its direct distribution. Otherwise, we average its direct and post-thinking distributions (Equation 10 ).
blocks.zh: 因此,思考费用在培训期间支付一次,而不是应要求支付一次。 思考对每一个问题都没有帮助。 如果老师已经有信心,没有推理的话,我们使用它的直接分布. 否则,我们平均其直接和思考后的分布(方程式10).

blocks.en: A.8 Step 6: refine in rounds and average the weights
blocks.zh: A.8 步骤6:以轮次细化并平均重量

blocks.en: After the conversion, five short training rounds follow. After every round, we average the new weights with the weights the round started from. This keeps what earlier rounds learned. A final stage retrains the model on a rebuilt data mixture, with targets pooled from several teachers (Section 3 ). The released model is the average of two such runs with different random seeds.
blocks.zh: 转会后,随后进行5轮短训. 每回合之后,我们平均新重量 与该回合开始的重量。 这让早期的回合学了。 最后一个阶段是在重建的数据混合物上重现模型,目标来自几位教师(第3节)。 发行的模型是两个这样的跑的平均值,有不同的随机种子.

blocks.en: A.9 What comes out
blocks.zh: A.9 联合国 出来什么

blocks.en: The finished model takes a prompt and returns one probability per option, in a single pass that takes a median of 92.9 ms. An application can take the most probable option. It can also act only when that probability is high enough, and pass the other cases to a person (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 完成的模型要迅速,每个选项返回一个概率,在一个中位数92.9毫秒的单个通过中. 申请可采取最可能的选择。 只有当这种概率足够高时,它才能采取行动,并将其他案件传给一个人(附录C)。

blocks.en: A.10 After GLiDE V1.2
blocks.zh: A.10 在GLIDE V1.2之后

blocks.en: Three later steps build on the finished model (Section 6 ). None changes the picture above: the model still returns one probability per option in a single pass. • Average in two more models. Two further models were trained on broader data. Their weights were averaged with those of GLiDE V1.2 . • Run some layers twice. GLiDE 27B applies two blocks of middle layers twice at inference, moving half-way each time. The model computes more per question with no new weights and no generated tokens. • Teach smaller models. Smaller models of the same design repeat the recipe. They are then trained to match the output distributions of the 27B model.
blocks.zh: 以后的三步以完成的模型为基础(第6节)。 上面的图片没有改变:模型仍然在一次通过中每个选项返回一个概率. • 平均再采用两种模式。 另外两个模型接受了关于更广泛数据的培训。 它们的权重平均为GLIDE V1.2。 GLiDE 27B在推论中两次应用两个中层块,每次移动半程. 模型以没有新重量和生成的符号来计算每个问题。 教比较小的模型. 同一种设计的较小的模型重复食谱. 然后对他们进行培训,使其与27B模型的输出分布相匹配。

blocks.en: Average in two more models. Two further models were trained on broader data. Their weights were averaged with those of GLiDE V1.2 .
blocks.zh: 平均在两个模型。 另外两个模型接受了关于更广泛数据的培训。 它们的权重与GLIDE V1.2的权重平均.

blocks.en: Run some layers twice. GLiDE 27B applies two blocks of middle layers twice at inference, moving half-way each time. The model computes more per question with no new weights and no generated tokens.
blocks.zh: 运行一些层两次。 GLiDE 27B在推论中两次应用两个中层块,每次移动半程. 模型在每题中计算得更多,没有新的重量,也没有生成的令牌.

blocks.en: Teach smaller models. Smaller models of the same design repeat the recipe. They are then trained to match the output distributions of the 27B model.
blocks.zh: 教比较小的模型. 同一种设计的较小的模型重复食谱. 然后对他们进行培训,使其与27B模型的输出分布相匹配。

blocks.en: Appendix B Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录B 相关工作

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation transfers a teacher’s soft distribution to a student ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Kim and Rush, 2016 ) , including information in the probability mass assigned to incorrect answers ( Menon et al., 2021 ) . Prior work has compressed chain-of-thought reasoning through sampled rationales, final answers, removed reasoning steps, or latent tokens ( Hsieh et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Goyal et al., 2024 ) . In contrast, we distill the complete post-thinking answer distribution, preserving the teacher’s residual uncertainty.
blocks.zh: Knowledge distractation将教师的软分发转移给一名学生(Hinton等人,2015年;Kim and Rush,2016年),包括分配给错误答案的概率质量信息(Menon等人,2021年). 先前的工作通过抽样推理、最后答案、去除推理步骤或潜伏符号压缩了思维推理链(Hsieh等人,2023年;Yu等人,2024年;Deng等人,2024年;Goyal等人,2024年)。 反之,我们提炼出完整的思考后答案分布,保留教师的剩余不确定性。

blocks.en: Schema-conditioned encoders such as GLiNER, GLiNER2, and GLiGuard support efficient prediction over natural-language labels or schemas ( Zaratiana et al., 2024 ; Zaratiana et al., 2025 ; Zaratiana et al., 2026a ; Zaratiana et al., 2026b ) . Work on non-causal decoders removes causal masks to produce strong representations ( BehnamGhader et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) ; in our hybrid decoder, we unmask only the full-attention layers. Because option-symbol scoring can introduce order bias ( Robinson et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) , we use a dedicated readout and shuffle options during training. Drex Max ( Dhankhar et al., 2026 ) , developed concurrently, uses the same backbone, also removes the causal mask, and also adds a 255-way readout. Its training differs: it adds consistency losses and a reinforcement-learning stage.
blocks.zh: 诸如GLiNER、GLiNER2和GLiGuard等有条件的编码器支持对自然语言标签或图案的有效预测(Zaratiana等人,2024年;Zaratiana等人,2025年;Zaratiana等人,2026年a;Zaratiana等人,2026年b) 。 非因果解码器的工作移除了因果口罩以产生强烈的表示力(BehnamGhader等人,2024年;Lee等人,2025年);在我们混合解码器中,我们只解码全心全意的层. 由于选项符号评分可以引入订单偏差(Robinson等人,2023年;Zheng等人,2024年),我们在训练时使用专用的读出和洗牌选项. Drex Max(Dhankhhar等人,2026年),同时开发,使用相同的骨干,也移除了因果面罩,并增加了255路读取. 其培训不同:增加了一致性损失和强化学习阶段.

blocks.en: Neural networks and language models are often overconfident ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Tian et al., 2023 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ) . Selective prediction therefore adds a reject mechanism ( Chow, 1970 ; Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ; Kamath et al., 2020 ) ; we train explicit abstention as an ordinary option and expose probabilities for application-level deferral.
blocks.zh: 神经网络和语言模型往往过于自信(Guo等人,2017年;Tian等人,2023年;Xiong等人,2024年). 因此,选择性预测增加了一个拒绝机制(Chow,1970年;Geifman和El-Yaniv,2017年;Kamath等人,2020年);我们培训明确弃权作为普通选项,并暴露应用级别推迟的可能性。

blocks.en: Appendix C Decision-model output semantics
blocks.zh: 附录C 决策模型输出语义

blocks.en: Section 2 defines how GLiDE V1.2 maps a context, question, and finite answer set to a categorical distribution. This appendix specifies how that distribution is interpreted by an application. It also makes explicit several operational properties that are separate from the network architecture: typed questions, cost-sensitive decisions, deferral, permutation equivariance, and the independence of batched questions.

blocks.en: C.2 Automation, deferral, and abstention
blocks.zh: C.2 自动化、推迟和弃权

blocks.en:
The model distribution and the application’s decision policy are distinct. A common selective policy ( Chow, 1970 ; Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ) automates only sufficiently confident predictions: δ τ ​ ( u j ) = { k ^ j , p ^ j ≥ τ , defer , p ^ j < τ . \delta_{\tau}(u_{j})=\begin{cases}\hat{k}_{j},&\hat{p}_{j}\geq\tau,\\
\mathrm{defer},&\hat{p}_{j}<\tau.\end{cases} On an evaluation set of N N questions, this policy has coverage Cov ( τ ) = 1 N ∑ j = 1 N 𝟏 [ p ^ j ≥ τ ] \operatorname{Cov}(\tau)=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{j=1}^{N}\mathbf{1}[\hat{p}_{j}\geq\tau] and selective risk Risk ⁡ ( τ ) = ∑ j 𝟏 [ p ^ j ≥ τ ] 𝟏 [ k ^ j ≠ y j ] ∑ j 𝟏 [ p ^ j ≥ τ ] . \operatorname{Risk}(\tau)=\frac{\sum_{j}\mathbf{1}[\hat{p}_{j}\geq\tau]\mathbf{1}[\hat{k}_{j}\neq y_{j}]}{\sum_{j}\mathbf{1}[\hat{p}_{j}\geq\tau]}. Increasing τ \tau usually lowers coverage and aims to lower risk; calibration determines whether confidence has a stable operational meaning on the deployment population. Deferral is not the same as explicit abstention. Deferral is imposed by the caller after inference and can use any threshold. Explicit abstention instead adds an “I don’t know” option ⊥ \bot to the candidate set, so that p j ∈ Δ K j , k ^ j ∈ { 1 , … , K j , ⊥ } . p_{j}\in\Delta^{K_{j}},\qquad\hat{k}_{j}\in\{1,\ldots,K_{j},\bot\}. It is therefore a behavior learned from training targets, not a post-hoc confidence rule. An application may combine both mechanisms: accept ⊥ \bot when the model selects it, and defer any remaining answer below a chosen confidence threshold.
C.3 Batched questions and independence

(p_{1},\ldots,p_{M})=\operatorname{BatchEval}_{\theta}(x_{1},\ldots,x_{M}). If an application interprets them independently, the induced joint distribution is p ⁡ ( k ^ 1 , … , k ^ M ∣ ℛ ) = ∏ j = 1 M p j ​ ( k ^ j ∣ c , q j , 𝒜 j ) . p(\hat{k}_{1},\ldots,\hat{k}_{M}\mid\mathcal{R})=\prod_{j=1}^{M}p_{j}(\hat{k}_{j}\mid c,q_{j},\mathcal{A}_{j}). blocks.en: C.4 Option order and semantic equivariance
blocks.zh: C.4 选择顺序和语义等效

blocks.en: Candidate order should not change the underlying decision. For a permutation π \pi of the K j K_{j} options, the desired equivariance property is p θ ​ ( π ⁡ ( k ) ∣ c , q j , π ⁡ ( 𝒜 j ) ) = p θ ​ ( k ∣ c , q j , 𝒜 j ) . p_{\theta}\!\left(\pi(k)\mid c,q_{j},\pi(\mathcal{A}_{j})\right)=p_{\theta}(k\mid c,q_{j},\mathcal{A}_{j}). This property is not guaranteed by the architecture because each option is paired with an ordered code and occupies a different prompt position. Shuffling options during training, while applying the same permutation to the target distribution, encourages approximate equivariance. Keeping the full option descriptions in the prompt also makes the prediction depend on their semantics rather than on a fixed meaning for code A, B, and so on.

blocks.en: D.2 Supervision path
blocks.zh: D.2 监督途径

blocks.en: The final stage does not train directly on raw labels alone. Its 374,720 questions first pass through format normalization and data-quality screening. Each retained row i i contains an input x i x_{i} , gold option y i y_{i} , task family f i f_{i} , and routed soft target q i q_{i} . For ordinary rows, q i q_{i} is the cross-fitted, task-specific log-linear teacher pool of Equation 12 ; incorrect teacher consensus is replaced by a gold-anchored target. Knowledge rows instead use the starting student’s own correctness and confidence to decide whether the target should favor the answer or the explicit abstention option. At each optimization step, the candidate options, their codes, the gold index, and every coordinate of q i q_{i} are permuted together. The student then minimizes Equation 11 . This ordering is important: teacher routing and gold anchoring define the target before option shuffling, while the shared permutation preserves its semantics and prevents a code position from becoming a label shortcut.
